correction.wrongRuleRemoved: the naive universal '>10 salariés OU >2 M€ CA ⇒ obligé' condition
correction.correctRule: EAA microenterprise SERVICE exemption = employees < 10 AND (turnoverEur ≤ 2 M€ OR balanceSheetEur ≤ 2 M€). The financial criterion is an OR (turnover OR balance sheet).
correction.productVsService: the microenterprise exemption applies ONLY to SERVICE providers; PRODUCT_OPERATOR / BOTH ⇒ OBLIGATED regardless of size (products are not covered by the service exemption)
correction.failClosed: unknown headcount OR unknown financials OR unknown role ⇒ NEEDS_DETERMINATION (never an assumed obligation or assumed exemption)
correction.noCertification: manualReviewRequired stays true; verdict cites source; explicitly NOT legal advice / NOT a certification

sources: Directive (EU) 2019/882 (EAA) Art. 4(5) — microenterprises providing services exempt from accessibility requirements
Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC — microenterprise = <10 persons AND (turnover ≤ €2M OR balance sheet ≤ €2M)
FR Code de la consommation L.412-13 — French transposition of the EAA obligations/exemptions
builtThisLot.sourceVerificationNote: legal thresholds encoded from the cited instruments; the applicability verdict is decision-support, NOT a legal determination or certification. Official-source/version verification remains an owner responsibility before any real use.
builtThisLot.edgeCasesLocked: 16 tests: <10&turnover≤2M; <10&balance≤2M (turnover high/unknown); ≥10 emp; both financials exceeded; service not in scope; product operator; BOTH; unknown emp/financials/role; garbage; and the specific V145-correction case (turnover 2.5M but balance ≤2M + <10 emp ⇒ EXEMPT).
